text:
alex: flagging a small but odd billing pattern after we flipped the new price-sheet 'omega-v1' to 10% cohort in eu-west — several accounts got two invoice lines for the same usage window.
maya: can you paste the quick dup query you ran?
alex: ran at 08:05 UTC:
```sql
SELECT account_id, billing_key, COUNT(*) cnt, MIN(created_at) first, MAX(created_at) last
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE price_sheet='omega-v1' AND region='eu-west' AND created_at >= '2026-03-27'
GROUP BY account_id, billing_key HAVING COUNT(*)>1 LIMIT 40;
```
ben: results? small amounts or big exposure?
alex: about 9 accounts, mostly <$40 each, one account ~ $350. duplicates within 20-90s windows.
sara: ops-bot run dedupe scan for 07:40-08:10 UTC and check for repeated request_id or billing_key writes.
ops-bot: acknowledged. running dedupe scan for 2026-03-27 07:40-08:10 UTC, will report in ~2m.
vendor-ops: I'll check webhook retries on our side too.
ops-bot: dedupe scan complete: 412 duplicated events on shard-5 between 07:50-07:58 UTC. likely overlapping writes from grandfathering job + realtime apply. digest stored at /var/logs/ingest/omega-dedupe-2039999999.log
ben: finance approval needed: auto-credit duplicates <= $50 and escalate >$50. max emergency exposure $2k. Approve emergency credits?
maya: I approve automated credits up to $50/account and manual review for >$50. ben?
ben: I concur. up to $50 automated; >$50 escalate to finance lead. :white_check_mark:
alex: ops please pause writes for omega-v1 in eu-west and prepare rollback option. what's the feature flag?
liam: (cc'd) flag is `pricing_router.omega_v1_enabled`. Ops can flip in Console.
sara: applying temporary write-lock for omega-v1 in eu-west (lock token lock-2039999999). TTL 30m.
ops-bot: write-lock applied by sara.
alex: billing ops please queue bulk dedupe job (dry-run first) and create FIN ticket for affected accounts.
sara: FIN-4999 created for bulk cleanup. billing ops dry-run succeeded. will run actual job after this thread confirms.
vendor-ops: vendor confirms 6 retries due to transient 502s from our ingestion endpoint during that window. will add retry jitter.
ben: ok proceed with bulk dedupe and credits <=$50, hold manual for the $350 account for finance review. tag me on that ticket.
maya: I'll run cohort reconciliation and post net-revenue delta by EOD. adding rollout SOP note: pause grandfathering job for 5m before flips.
ops-bot: INF-3488 created: "ingest: idempotent webhook handling + flaky retry mitigation" assigned to eng-infra.
sara: running the cleanup now. will update when credits posted.
ben: thanks team, keep thread pinned until reconciliation posted.
ops-bot: archival reminder: this thread will be auto-archived in 90 days."
